short_description: Somany Duragres Grande El Sedona Crema FP, 600x1200 mm full-polished glazed vitrified tile in cream marble, 2 tiles per box covering 15.5 sqft.
long_description:
## What it is

Grande El Sedona Crema FP (article T31F119001859102) is a glazed vitrified tile from Duragres, Somany's GVT range. It is a dry-pressed porcelain body carrying a digitally printed cream marble design under a full-polished glaze, in a rectified 600 x 1200 mm module, 9 mm thick.

## What it's for

Somany lists it for bedrooms, living rooms and kitchens - the 2 x 4 ft format that a builder in Andhra Pradesh or Telangana specifies when the brief is a continuous polished marble-look floor with few joints. The same tile carries onto walls and feature panels so the veining reads as one surface. A PEI IV abrasion class and a vitrified body cover domestic traffic and light-commercial interiors. With an R9 slip class and a polished face it belongs indoors, in dry areas - not on balconies, terraces or open parking.

## Key specifications

The body is Group BIa vitrified porcelain with water absorption at or below 0.5%, the property that keeps a polished large format stable and stain-tolerant. Breaking strength is taken at 1300 N and modulus of rupture at 35 N/mm², to IS 15622 and the ISO 10545 test series, with surface hardness around MOHS 6 and stain resistance Class 5. Dimensional tolerance is held to 0.6%, so rectified edges close on a 2 mm joint. Somany was the first tile maker in India to carry a BIS mark on glazed vitrified tiles, from the year Duragres production began, and was certified by the Green Building Council in the same year.

## Application and installation notes

Fix thin-bed over a levelled, fully cured screed with a polymer-modified adhesive to IS 15477 - Somany's own EzyFix is the matched product. Back-butter each tile so nothing is hollow under a 1200 mm span, hold joints at 2 mm, and check the box batch before laying, since shade variation is V2.

## What's in the box

One box holds 2 tiles covering 1.44 m² (about 15.5 sqft) and weighs about 31 kg. Sold by the box under HSN 6907 at 18% GST.
